title: GuvFX Canonical Candles Parquet Column Contract v1
description: The canonical analytical candle payload is Parquet (NDJSON is permitted ONLY as optional raw evidence; NDJSON-only canonical releases are not canonical-import eligible). This contract DESCRIBES the mandatory Parquet column surface, logical+physical types, UTC unit, decimal precision, integer widths, nullability and the uniqueness key; the authoritative enforcement is research/market_data/tim_contracts_v0_3.py against a read-back Parquet schema. UTC REPRESENTATION (GFX-PKT-TIM-C3 / K-2): timestamps are stored as microsecond-precision UTC-naive values; the Parquet logical type carries isAdjustedToUTC=FALSE (which is what the DuckDB writer emits), and UTC is asserted by THIS CONTRACT and the column naming (every instant column ends _utc), NOT by the Parquet isAdjustedToUTC flag. parquet_isadjustedtoutc records that physical truth so the descriptor and the writer agree. time_semantics names the seven distinct instants the pipeline keeps separate; quality_flags_semantics defines the per-bar quality_flags bitset (K-9). GFX-PKT-TIM-C2, v0.3; corrected by GFX-PKT-TIM-C3. Synthetic/design contract.

uniqueness_key.description: Columns that uniquely identify a candle row within a release (event_start_utc).

native_vs_derived.description: Native/derived identity is carried by the release manifest provenance/derivation, never inferred from the candle rows.

parquet_isadjustedtoutc.description: The physical Parquet timestamp logical-type flag the writer emits. FALSE: timestamps are UTC-naive microseconds; UTC is asserted by this contract and the _utc column naming, not by the flag (GFX-PKT-TIM-C3 / K-2).

time_semantics.description: The seven distinct instants the pipeline keeps separate (never collapsed). TIM import time is consumer-side (recorded on the import receipt), not in the candle row.

quality_flags_semantics.description: Definition of the per-bar quality_flags UINT32 bitset (GFX-PKT-TIM-C3 / K-9). A row with quality_flags==0 is clean; any non-zero bit records a per-bar quality concern. Validators count non-zero rows and do NOT reinterpret bits beyond this definition.
